title: EdgeFile X7: the route from access to apex
topic: The manufacturer's EdgeFile X7 shaping sequence and settings as a metro map, with the habits and the one evidence flag that go with it.

claims.claim: Line info: speed 300–500 rpm; torque limit 300 g·cm (= 2.94 N·cm); apical pressure minimal
claims.source: Manufacturer directions, not evidence. Speed and torque limit: EdgeEndo, Instructions for Use – EdgeFile X7, REF 99.EX7.10.01A.XX ('IFU 2026'), edgeendo.com, accessed 22 Nov 2026 (section 1) and EdgeEndo, Rotary/Reciprocating Files Directions for Use, DFU-RF-US Rev D 06/23 ('US DFU 2023'), edgeendo.com, accessed 22 Nov 2026. 'Minimal apical pressure' is in the US DFU only

claims.claim: Route: ACCESS straight-line → SCOUT with hand files → WORKING LENGTH with a #10 K or larger (apex locator and radiograph pictograms) = glide path
claims.source: Manufacturer: EdgeEndo, Instructions for Use – EdgeFile X7, REF 99.EX7.10.01A.XX ('IFU 2026'), edgeendo.com, accessed 22 Nov 2026, 'Simplified Technique Guide' steps 1, 2 and 4 (this technique is printed in the IFU 2026 only)

claims.claim: Evidence · in vitro: glide path first, file lasted about 6× longer (ProTaper S1 in resin blocks: mean 59 vs 10 blocks before breakage)
claims.source: Berutti et al., J Endod 2004;30(4):228-30 (PMID 15085052); abstract only; conventional NiTi, not EdgeFile X7

claims.claim: 17/.04, then 25/.04; 20/.04 only if the 25 won't reach length (alternate 20 and 25)
claims.source: Manufacturer: EdgeEndo, Instructions for Use – EdgeFile X7, REF 99.EX7.10.01A.XX ('IFU 2026'), edgeendo.com, accessed 22 Nov 2026, 'Simplified Technique Guide' steps 5-6

claims.claim: Every file: irrigate · recap #10/#15 · clean flutes · inspect
claims.source: Manufacturer: IFU 2026 step 3 (irrigate before each hand or rotary file) and section 5 (clean flutes, inspect, discard if distorted); 'recapitulate with a #10 or #15' is the crown-down wording in IFU 2026 and DFU-RF-US Rev D 06/23

claims.claim: If wanted: larger .04 (all canals) or larger .06 (straight to mildly curved); drawn with a white core = conditional service
claims.source: Manufacturer: IFU 2026 step 7 (larger .04 or .06 instruments if the clinician desires); the taper rule comes from the crown-down section headings (IFU 2026; DFU-RF-US Rev D 06/23), no angle is given

Final irrigation station = convention, not an IFU 2026 step. Cone fit: IFU 2026 and DFU-RF-US Rev D 06/23 ('may need to drop down in cone tip size'); Keith et al., J Endod 2024;50(12):1766-71 (PMID 39393517; abstract, EdgeTaper Platinum not X7)

claims.claim: One patient · one procedure · then discard; max 4 canals per file (IFU 2026); follow the current DFU
claims.source: Manufacturer: IFU 2026 section 5 ('up to four (4) canals during a single procedure. Discard after use'); DFU-RF-US Rev D 06/23 says 'single use only'

claims.claim: Alternative service: crown-down 25 → 20 → (17), each to resistance (US DFU 2023)
claims.source: Manufacturer: DFU-RF-US Rev D 06/23, X7 '04 Taper Crown Down for All Canals' (the only sequence in the US-labelled DFU; also printed in IFU 2026)

claims.claim: Fine print: manufacturer IFU 2026 / US DFU 2023 + evidence-informed habits; no sequence is proven 'most efficient'
claims.source: No study comparing EdgeFile X7 sequences found on PubMed (searches of 22 Nov 2026, see RESEARCH.md); Peters OA, J Endod 2004;30(8):559-67 (PMID 15273636; abstract) lists instrument sequence among the less significant factors

caption:
EdgeFile X7, access to apex, as a transit map.

Main line = manufacturer's simplified technique (IFU 2026): #10 K or larger to length (= glide path) → 17/.04 → 25/.04, 20/.04 only if the 25 won't reach. Larger .04/.06 only if wanted. 300–500 rpm, torque limit 300 g·cm.
The US DFU (2023) prints crown-down only: check your leaflet.
PubMed, Nov 2026: no study compares X7 sequences, so none is proven "most efficient". Glide-path flag: in vitro (ProTaper S1, resin blocks).

Refs: EdgeEndo IFU EdgeFile X7 + DFU-RF-US Rev D (accessed Nov 2026); Berutti 2004, J Endod
